claims: The 130th Boston Marathon will take place on Monday, April 20, 2026.
The Boston Marathon is known as the world's oldest annual marathon.
The Boston Marathon is held on Patriots' Day.
The Boston Marathon is a 26.22-mile race.
The Boston Marathon features six start waves.
The Boston Marathon is expected to attract over 24,000 participants.
The Boston Marathon has a cut-off time of 4:34 for qualifying applicants.
Elite wheelchair starts for the 2026 Boston Marathon are around 9:00 a.m.
Professional waves for the 2026 Boston Marathon start around 9:37 a.m.
Six waves for the 2026 Boston Marathon will depart between 10:00 a.m. and roughly 11:30 a.m.
The 2026 Boston Marathon runs from Hopkinton to Boston.
The 2026 Boston Marathon course features a net downhill start.
The 2026 Boston Marathon course has significant hills later in the course.
Registration for the Boston Marathon is available through the Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.).
For the 2026 Boston Marathon, 24,362 runners were accepted out of 33,249 applications.
Qualifying standard for the 2026 Boston Marathon is 2:55:00 for men 18–34.
Qualifying standard for the 2026 Boston Marathon is 3:45:00 for women 45-49.
The 2026 Boston Marathon starts in Hopkinton, MA.
The 2026 Boston Marathon finishes on Boylston Street in Boston.
The 2026 Boston Marathon course is a net downhill for the first 4-5 miles.
The 2026 Boston Marathon course has challenging hills in Newton.
The 2026 Boston Marathon medals feature a shield with a black and gold design.
The Boston Marathon is organized by the Boston Athletic Association.
